name: joxo
description: Joxo for Claude Code: the setup skill, a live channel for teammates' messages and handoffs, and a mod that shows your team's work as it happens.

nodePath.title: Node.js path
nodePath.description: Absolute path of the node that runs joxo. `joxo setup` fills this in; leave it empty and run joxo setup.

joxoPath.title: joxo path
joxoPath.description: Absolute path of joxo.mjs (usually ~/.joxo/bin/joxo.mjs). `joxo setup` fills this in; leave it empty and run joxo setup.
